name: ghcp-usage-metrics
description: Local dashboard of your GitHub Copilot AI-credit and token usage per project, model, harness, agent, skill and day, with cost ranking, strengths and forecasting. Runs the bundled Python extractor (usage.py) and hosts its report in a webview. Refresh re-scans your logs live. Nothing leaves your machine. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by Microsoft or GitHub.

ghcpUsage.pythonPath.description: Python interpreter used to run usage.py (e.g. 'python', 'python3', or an absolute path).

ghcpUsage.repoPath.description: Folder containing usage.py. Empty = auto-detect from the open workspace folders, then the parent folder of this extension, then the bundled copy.

ghcpUsage.quickScanDays.description: On a first run with no previous report, scan only logs from the last N days so the dashboard appears quickly. The complete history is then loaded in the background.

enumDescriptions: Prefer Copilot Chat's request logs and let VS Code's saved sessions fill in what they no longer hold. Falls back to saved sessions on machines that have no request logs.
Read Copilot Chat's request logs only. Sessions the logs have rotated away are left out.
Read VS Code's saved sessions only. Works without request logs, but saved sessions keep only the most recent turns and carry an AI-credit figure only from the date VS Code began writing one.
ghcpUsage.source.description: Which local store to build the report from.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run check-version && npm run compile && npm run bundle
scripts.package: node scripts/clean-vsix.js && npm run bundle && npx --yes @vscode/vsce package --allow-missing-repository
